name: Play.ai / PlayHT
positioning: PlayHT (later branded PlayAI) was a text-to-speech and voice-cloning API provider that third-party sources report was acquired by Meta in 2025 and shut down.

pricing.model: No current pricing: the vendor's marketing and pricing domains no longer resolve.
pricing.headline: No live pricing available; the service appears to be discontinued.

voices.languages: Historical docs list Play 3.0 Mini as multilingual and PlayDialog multilingual in beta (docs last updated 2025-09-15).
voices.customVoiceOrCloning: Historical docs describe voice cloning on Play 2.0, 3.0 Mini and PlayDialog.

streaming.vendorStatedLatency: Vendor-stated (historical docs): time to first audio 230 ms (Play 2.0), 190 ms (Play 3.0 Mini), 350 ms (PlayDialog). Service no longer available.

compatibility.note: Historical API used its own /api/v2/tts/stream endpoint with X-USER-ID and AUTHORIZATION headers. Its API host no longer resolves.

compliance.note: No compliance statements were read; the vendor's marketing site is offline.

strengths.claim: Historical docs (last updated 2025-09-15) describe PlayDialog as an emotive model for turn-based multi-voice dialogue, and Play 3.0 Mini as built for fast bulk generation.
Historical docs offered both HTTP streaming and a WebSocket API, with Node.js and Python SDKs.

limitations.claim: At retrieval (2026-10-10) play.ht, play.ai and api.play.ht did not resolve in DNS from the research host; a static docs site (docs.play.ht) remained. Third-party reports state the service closed on 2025-12-31.

stepsToMove: The PlayHT API (https://api.play.ht/api/v2/tts/stream) no longer resolves, so existing integrations must move to another provider.
Replace the request body fields text, voice, voice_engine and output_format with the corresponding ReadAloud fields.
Replace the X-USER-ID and AUTHORIZATION headers with the ReadAloud bearer key.
Cloned voices were held by the vendor and cannot be assumed to be exportable.

bestFor: Not applicable: the service appears discontinued. Developers who relied on it need a replacement TTS provider.

sources.title: Murf AI: Play AI / Play HT transition guide (competitor blog, secondary source)

unknowns: Official shutdown date and Meta acquisition terms (primary announcement not read; a competitor blog and search-result summaries, which report an acquisition by Meta and closure by 2025-12-31)
Whether any successor product or API exists under Meta
Status relies on DNS non-resolution observed by the researcher plus secondary reports
statusNote: No page is published. On 2026-10-10 play.ht, play.ai and api.play.ht did not resolve in DNS from the research host; only docs.play.ht (a static docs site) answered. The closure is known only from secondary reports (a competitor blog and search-result summaries); no primary announcement was read, so no claim about the company is made.
